Owner choice. Fit out as ordinary rentals first, or furnish for serviced stays once demand and management arrangements are established. Physical

No occupancy, room-rate or revenue projections are assumed. Confirm the local accommodation classification, fire strategy, parking provision and operating permissions before selecting short-stay use.

TO DEVELOP BEFORE SCHEMATIC DESIGN
Survey + permissions. Confirm legal boundary, bearings, road width/reservation, approved land use, setbacks,
floor-area/height controls and levels along the entire frontage. The drawn envelope is a feasibility assumption,
not a zero-setback approval.
Frame + ground. Coordinate geotechnical advice, excavation support beside the raised road, retaining walls,
foundations, seismic frame behaviour and parking waterproofing. Columns shown in the plans are indicative only.
Access + operations. Develop the assumed footpath-side parking connection and obtain a passenger-lift layout.
Confirm the allowed single-stair strategy, fire separation, travel distance and accessible routes for the chosen
occupancy.
Services + demand. Confirm water, sewer/outfall, power, drainage, mechanical ventilation and metering. Check
actual tenant demand and short-stay permissions before fixing fit-outs or operating assumptions.
REFERENCE BASIS
Client-supplied SITE PLAN-2(1).pdf and AYAZ AHMED SHAIKH BHADERWAH.pdf, dated September 2026; client Google Earth screenshots and stated level difference. Prior Floor_Plans_v5 layout not adopted.
Regulatory reference: J&K Unified Building Bye-Laws 2021; current local provisions to verify.
